The '''Jaminere system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jaminere/Legends|Jaminere]].
